$comment: Traceability: reply to worker.inputs.fetch. One chunk per request; the worker keeps fetching with advancing offsets until eof. data is base64 of at most 256 KiB (349528 chars).

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

data.description: Base64-encoded chunk bytes, at most 256 KiB.

eof.description: True when this chunk ends the input.

total_size.description: Total input size in bytes, so the worker can bound reassembly.

title: service.inputs.data
